objects.description: [PowerSploit](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0194)'s Get-ProcessTokenGroup Privesc-PowerUp module can enumerate all SIDs associated with its current token.(Citation: GitHub PowerSploit May 2012)(Citation: PowerSploit Documentation)
